el.Hacemos juegos, vos los vivís. Estamos c: We make games, you live them. We're creating Astral Remembrance.
el.Somos Spam Studios: cinco personas, una: We are Spam Studios: five people, one shared vision. We're making Astral Remembrance, an indie journey of exploration, contemplation and discovery where every landscape and every decision matters.
el.Buscamos la fuerza narrativa y audiovisu: We aim for the narrative and audiovisual power of works like Shadow of the Colossus, without losing the identity of an independent project. The prologue will be the playable demo, and the journey begins in 2026.
